verdict.rationale: Conta Simples documents per-card limits that enforce a spending ceiling for each purpose: virtual cards are issued "com limite certo para cada objetivo," assigned to owners, and VCN ceilings and controls can be adjusted. It also mentions an approvals area and cost centers, but cost centers are documented only for classifying expenses, and nothing shows budgets allocated to teams or projects or being enforced by limits or approvals. missing for 10: explicit team/project budget allocation, budget enforcement tied to cost centers, documented approval workflows that block over-budget spend, independent or hands-on corroboration.

support.subject: As a finance lead, I can allocate budgets to teams and projects and have card limits and approvals actually enforce them

citations.quote: Emita cartões virtuais em 1 clique, com limite certo para cada objetivo.
Crie cartões específicos para gastos com viagens, softwares ou anúncios e atribua aos responsáveis.
For CUSTOM, Update VCN tops up the ceiling, extends or shortens the window and adjusts the controls, without replacing the card.
